appears to the State Government that the Council has failed to
exercise or has exceeded or abused a power conferred, or has failed
to perform a duty imposed, upon it by this Act, the State
Government may, if it considers such failure, excess or abuse to be

within such time as may be fixed by the State Government, may
dissolve the Council and cause all or any of the powers and duties
of the Council to be exercised and performed by such agency and
for such period, not exceeding six months, as it may think fit:

Council before the expiry of six months from the date of its
dissolution.
